component.name: LAMPP Panel
component.summary: Control panel for a local Apache, MariaDB and PHP stack

description.p: Start, stop, restart and monitor a local web development stack on Fedora: Apache, MariaDB, PHP-FPM, vsftpd, Postfix and Tomcat. Missing services can be installed from the panel. Includes a project launcher, log and config viewers, and database backup. Privileged actions go through polkit.
Uses the distribution's own packages and systemd units. XAMPP is not required, and this project is not affiliated with Apache Friends or XAMPP.
